description:
Approved by the user ("New :unicode_util ticket first", relayed by Elixir Parity 2026-11-20). Owner: Elixir Parity.

:unicode_util.cp/1 and gc/1 return the next codepoint and the next grapheme cluster of any chardata: lists, binaries and nested chardata, with {error, Bin} for a malformed binary, as OTP does. gc shares String.next_grapheme_size's existing grapheme-break tables, so there is one implementation of the break rules. OTP generates unicode_util.erl at build time, so there is no source in ../otp to port; the spec is OTP's documented behaviour, probed with erl and elixir.

Blocks fz-mue.9 (:string.take/next_codepoint, which json.erl:785-786 calls on charlists).
title: :unicode_util.cp/1 and gc/1 take the next codepoint and grapheme cluster of any chardata, as in OTP
